cases.title: 03 · Conflicting source records
cases.description: Active specification says fragrance-free but a fictional quality-control record says added fragrance. Preflight fails closed before any model call.

cases.title: 04 · Superseded formulation
cases.description: The sunscreen's mineral label is stale: a later fictional revision asserts the opposite. The guard blocks this required attribute.

cases.title: 05 · Required source is missing
cases.description: The cleanser metadata says fragrance-free but its authored source only states the price, so the evidence gate abstains.

cases.title: 06 · Budget hard-filter
cases.description: A $5 cap excludes all fictional moisturizers. Retrieval returns no eligible candidate and generation is skipped.
